intent: A sun–moon theme button and a Light / System / Dark switch sharing one mode; the new theme wipes across the page in a circle from the pressed control.

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 plus one namespaced <style> (tt-)
stack.animation: CSS transitions for the cross-rotating glyphs; motion/react layoutId for the segmented pill; View Transitions + Web Animations for the circular reveal

layout.icon: 36×36 button (32 sm), radius 10px, 18px glyph box; sun r4 + 8 rays; crescent moon
layout.segmented: 3px-padded well radius 11px; three 32px segments (28 sm), 16px glyph + 6px gap + label, 12px padding; icon-only square segments when labels=false
layout.stage: 56px header with wordmark and icon toggle; reading card; Appearance row with the segmented switch (stacks under @sm)

color.approach: monochrome; the theme itself is the content, no accent

motion.glyphs: cross-rotate ±90°, scale 0.5, fade, 450ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); rays extend 0→1 over 260ms from 120ms, 28ms apart
motion.reveal: View Transition; ::view-transition-new(root) clip-path circle(0) → farthest corner from the control centre, 560ms cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1); update resolves after React commits (layout effect), 320ms safety timeout; overrides scoped to an <html> class during the reveal; skipped when nothing visible changes

responsive: Fixed-size controls; the stage's readout appears from @sm and the Appearance row stacks under @sm; works from 320px.
accessibility: Icon button aria-label names the action and aria-pressed reflects dark; matching title
Segmented is role=radiogroup labelled Theme with role=radio segments, aria-checked and roving tabindex
Arrow keys, Home and End move and select
Icon-only segments keep accessible names and tooltips
Focus-visible 2px ink ring, offset 2px, no transition
System mode follows prefers-color-scheme changes live

content.card: Night mode is a promise about 2 a.m.

avoid: Transitioning every colour on the page instead of a single reveal
Global view-transition overrides left active outside the reveal
Yellow suns, blue moons, starry skeuomorphic switches
A wipe when nothing visible changes
Blocking the switch where View Transitions are unsupported
